notes: The supplied original locator is only “p. 13” and does not identify a study/test. The assigned replication report explicitly selects Experiment 5 and its three-way interaction, locating the original statistic on journal p. 74 (PDF page 14 with the downloaded cover). The requested original OR is not printed for this test: the printed B is preserved without conversion. The replication requested es_type ser_method is not a printed metric; its printed B is preserved. Original 138 is a recruitment count and is not silently promoted to analytic n. The Stage2 report instructions refer to a Stage1-named data file; no pilot and final statistics were combined. PDF text extraction renders equals signs as p and less-than signs as !; quotes preserve that frozen text representation.
